## v1.10.0 — 2026-03-21

This release, v1.10.0, delivers significant advancements in production readiness, security hardening, and infrastructure stability. Key features include a new private package for paid tiers and enhanced CLI usage metering. The release also incorporates crucial fixes across security, packaging, and CI pipelines, alongside extensive improvements to testing coverage, documentation management, and build processes, ensuring a more robust and consistent developer experience.

### ✨ Features

- Implemented production launch hardening for gates 7-12, ensuring robust system stability and readiness.
- Introduced a private `@cullit/licensed` package to support paid tiers, enabling differentiated distribution models.
- Wired `reportUsage` metering into the CLI, which activates after a successful generation, providing insights into tool adoption.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Enhanced overall ship-readiness with additional hardening measures for v1.10.0.
- Aligned the pricing navbar branding with the site-wide style for a consistent user experience.
- Strengthened CI/CD processes by hardening readiness guards, implementing local pre-push gates, syncing legal text checks, aligning pricing checks with current markup, and improving the Docker build environment to install Playwright browser and honor pnpm configuration.
- Refined documentation by removing internal architecture docs from the public repository surface and enhancing internal architecture documentation with system flow diagrams and an enforced document synchronization policy.
- Expanded testing coverage with new Playwright dashboard tier gating smoke tests and comprehensive API tier workflow matrix coverage for free, pro, team, and enterprise tiers.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Resolved issues with lockfile consistency and fixed CI installation processes, ensuring reliable builds.
- Restored the root package name to `cullit` and reverted previous pricing changes, correcting earlier misconfigurations.
- Addressed multiple audit findings, including security vulnerabilities, packaging inconsistencies, pricing inaccuracies, site accuracy issues, npm package messaging alignment, and normalization of navigation CTA CSS.
- Migrated the lint configuration for ESLint 10 and resolved CI lint failures specifically in markdown formatter tests.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated the project version to 1.10.0, with an intermediate bump to 1.9.3 that included typing integration boundaries.
- Conducted multiple lint passes to significantly reduce warning noise in runtime code and bring lint warnings below the launch threshold.
- Renamed internal documentation directories to `architecture-docs` and `cullit-ea`, and integrated an EA docs audit workflow.
- Bumped the development dependency `eslint` from 8.57.1 to 10.0.3.

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @dependabot[bot]
